Public, synthetic-key research fixture. This is not evidence of chain admission.

withdrawal wire SHA256: 4f53da1ce9c4017d34959ae363acb3c4e8fe7c4508d8aa821da71ec8fe2c113e
parent reward-spend wire SHA256: 8be913fdab58df0b0e507c53a2915c3e69dcff1df9b18883d57354413fe8fe40
upstream shielded sighash (raw bytes): 42f6311ad7276f7a3edb013ea395fdb2fe8b9089f18fe60e77b8164d47bd87dc
projected anchor (raw bytes): 382ccad224a7e382b6e18d38beb6f518ef9a30ea0a0cc259aa9021737d41cf22

Recipe: parse the parent as NU6.3 v6; derive the external incoming viewing
key from the public test-only Orchard SpendingKey [0; 32]; decrypt the note
of value 1249985000 at action 1. Append both parent action commitments in wire
order to an empty depth-32 Orchard tree and retain the witness for position 1.
This anchor is usable on a chain only if those are its first two Ironwood
commitments and the parent transaction actually enters that chain.

Use the retained librustzcash builder with all upgrades active from height 1,
target height 146, the witness root as Ironwood anchor, default padding,
this note and its test-only SpendAuthorizingKey, and one transparent P2PKH
output with hash160 [0x42; 20] for 1249970000 zatoshi. The ZIP317 fee is
15000; there are no transparent inputs. Use ChaCha20Rng seeded with [0x43; 32].
The upstream builder.rs SHA256 is 94a04abdf166f767d6bfec1b0c65b1d2d7bc3db712bababa839e3cb222ee6ead;
Cargo.lock SHA256 is 87f36c41a12da5a7430547c754aa52640ecfd52c939cf16fb0534e7f91b851cf;
the experimental builder harness SHA256 is 0ce2146a2d5d0918fbcb034b9229164205a10e12b09ae11ed9ce9ada1582b27a.
The local snapshot is not a Git checkout; these are byte identities, not a
claimed upstream commit. Rust 1.89 and the snapshot compiled dependencies
were used. Independent upstream verification passed its proof, both action
signatures and binding signature, and rejected a changed signature hash.
